func:
let data = msg.payload;

msg.topic = `
INSERT INTO electrode 
(electrode_id, product_count, IR_temp_1, IR_temp_2, chain_speed, zone_temp_1, zone_temp_2, electrode_type)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
    product_count = VALUES(product_count),
    IR_temp_1   = VALUES(IR_temp_1),
    IR_temp_2   = VALUES(IR_temp_2),
    chain_speed = VALUES(chain_speed),
    zone_temp_1 = VALUES(zone_temp_1),
    zone_temp_2 = VALUES(zone_temp_2),
    electrode_type  = VALUES(electrode_type);
`;

msg.payload = [
    data.id,
    data.anode_count,
    data.irTemp1,
    data.irTemp2,
    data.chain_speed,
    data.z1Temp,
    data.z2Temp,
    data.type
];

return msg;

let data = msg.payload;

msg.topic = `
INSERT INTO electrode 
(electrode_id, product_count, IR_temp_1, IR_temp_2, IR_temp_3, 
 chain_speed, zone_temp_1, zone_temp_2, humidity, electrode_type)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
    product_count = VALUES(product_count),
    IR_temp_1   = VALUES(IR_temp_1),
    IR_temp_2   = VALUES(IR_temp_2),
    IR_temp_3   = VALUES(IR_temp_3),
    chain_speed = VALUES(chain_speed),
    zone_temp_1 = VALUES(zone_temp_1),
    zone_temp_2 = VALUES(zone_temp_2),
    humidity    = VALUES(humidity),
    electrode_type  = VALUES(electrode_type);
`;

msg.payload = [
    data.id_c,
    data.cathode_count,
    data.irTemp1_c,
    data.irTemp2_c,
    data.irTemp3_c,
    data.chain,
    data.z1Temp_c,
    data.z2Temp_c,
    data.humidity,
    data.type
];

return msg;
